Title: Insufficient funds
Body: Your character does not have enough money for this activity.

Title: Activity unavailable
Body: Check your project stage. Recording needs a draft, mixing needs a recording, and release needs 100% production. A collaborator, campaign or equipment upgrade can only be chosen once.

Title: Studio schedule full
Body: You have used your six studio work sessions this year. Age up to refresh your schedule.

Title: Music Studio
Body: You can open a studio from age 16.

Title: Open your studio
Body: Start an independent production career. Your studio audience and catalogue belong to this character.

Title: Choose your next project
Body: Pick a release format. Larger projects earn more streams but require more work.

Title: Choose a sound
Body: Your release will keep this genre in the catalogue.

Title: Name your project
Body: Choose a working title. Release numbers distinguish projects in your catalogue.
